name: Advanced Image Media Attributes Formatter
description: Adds fetchpriority and decoding attributes (and a loading override for media) to image and media field output.
project_description: Advanced Image Media Attributes Formatter adds UI controls for modern HTML image performance attributes to Drupal's existing Image and Rendered-entity (media) formatters. Instead of shipping new formatter plugins, it uses hook_field_formatter_info_alter() to swap the class behind core's 'image' and 'entity_reference_entity_view' formatters, so the extra options appear inline in the familiar Manage-display and Views formatter settings. For plain Image fields it exposes 'fetchpriority' (high/low/auto/none) and 'decoding' (async/sync/auto/none) dropdowns. For media reference fields rendered as entities it adds an 'Override image loading' checkbox that lets you pick the inner image field, set loading=lazy or loading=eager, and apply the same fetchpriority and decoding hints. Attributes are attached to the image render arrays through a pre-render callback so they flow into the standard image, image_style and image_formatter theme output, including image styles and responsive images. Typical use is improving Core Web Vitals such as Largest Contentful Paint by marking hero images fetchpriority=high/eager and lazy-loading below-the-fold images. No new configuration pages, content types, permissions, routes or services are created.
